extracted.intended_audience: doctoral/postdoctoral fellowship applicants preparing NIH F99/K00 (PHS Fellowship) applications and their sponsors/mentors
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing and resubmitting an NIH PHS Fellowship (F99/K00) application, including completing the PHS Fellowship Supplemental Form, addressing reviewer critiques, and documenting training plans, mentorship, resources, and regulatory questions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Introduction to Application (resubmission)
rubrics_metrics.description: For resubmission applications include an Introduction that summarizes changes made in response to prior review and synthesizes reviewer feedback into priority areas and steps taken to address each concern.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clearly state how critiques were addressed (e.g., adding co-sponsors, enriching training plan, adding courses/internships), and map changes to reviewer concerns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant's Background and Goals for Fellowship Training
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a narrative of the applicant's prior research, clinical and training experiences, and articulate long-term career development objectives and how the fellowship will enable them.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include past research projects, publications, internships, cross-cultural experience, and explicit statement of commitment to the proposed research population and goals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specific Aims
rubrics_metrics.description: State the Specific Aims of the proposed research project (file reference 14_SPECIFIC_AIMS).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aims should align with the training goals and be feasible within the fellowship period; tie aims to measurable outputs (e.g., manuscripts, pilot data).

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the Research Strategy (file reference 15_RESEARCH_STRATEGY) describing approach, significance, innovation, and methods for the proposed project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Demonstrate methodological rigor and justify mixed-methods approaches when used; describe use of existing datasets/cohorts and how training will support the research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Respective Contributions
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe the respective contributions of applicant, sponsor(s), co-sponsor(s), collaborators and consultants to training and research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include roles and division of mentoring responsibilities and how each sponsor contributes to training aims (file reference 16__RESPECTIVE_CONTRIBUTIONS).

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection of Sponsor and Institution
rubrics_metrics.description: Justify choice of sponsor(s) and institution, including institutional resources and plan for relocation/engagement (file reference 17__SELECTION_OF_SPONSOR___INST).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detail sponsor expertise, institutional cores, meetings, and how the environment will support transition from F99 to K00 stages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Progress Report / Publication List (for renewal)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a progress report and publication list for renewal applications (file: Progress Report Publication List).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document productivity (papers published, under review) to demonstrate training outcomes and research momentum.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training in the Responsible Conduct of Research (RCR)
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe planned training in Responsible Conduct of Research (file reference 18__TRAINING_IN_RCR).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify courses, mentorship, and activities to ensure ethical research conduct appropriate for the field.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sponsor and Co-Sponsor Statements
rubrics_metrics.description: Include statements from sponsor(s) and co-sponsor(s) detailing mentorship plans, meeting frequency, and training responsibilities (file reference 19_SPONSOR_AND_CO_SPONSOR_STMT).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a sponsor team coordination plan (e.g., biweekly online meetings during F99, weekly in-person during K00) and commitments from named mentors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Letters of Support from Collaborators, Contributors and Consultants
rubrics_metrics.description: Attach letters of support that document collaborators' contributions and access to data, resources, or training opportunities (file: Letters_of_Support).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Letters should confirm roles (e.g., neuroimaging mentorship, access to datasets) and planned interactions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Description of Institutional Environment and Commitment to Training
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe institutional environment, cores, and formal commitments that will support the trainee (items 11 and related FACILITIES & OTHER RESOURCES).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be specific about cores (e.g., MRI Core, Data Core), investigator meetings, and resources available at both F99 and K00 institutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Description of Candidate's Contribution to Program Goals
rubrics_metrics.description: Explain how the candidate's activities will contribute to the sponsoring program's training and research goals (item 12).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tie candidate responsibilities and planned outputs to program aims and institutional priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vertebrate Animals Usage and Euthanasia Compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: Declare whether vertebrate animals are used; if euthanasia is planned, state if method is consistent with AVMA guidelines or provide justification if not.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If animals are used, include method details and scientific justification for deviations from AVMA guidelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select Agent Research
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether the proposed work involves select agents (item 15).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If yes, follow applicable policies and include containment/security plans.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resource Sharing Plan
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a plan for data/resource sharing (item 16).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detail how data, code, or materials (e.g., digital biomarkers, annotated datasets) will be shared consistent with funder policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authentication of Key Biological and/or Chemical Resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe plans to authenticate key biological/chemical resources used in the project (item 17).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide methods to validate cell lines, reagents, and other critical resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human Embryonic Stem Cells Disclosure
rubrics_metrics.description: Declare whether the project involves human embryonic stem cells; if yes, list registry numbers or state that a registry line will be used (item 18).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow agency instructions for registry citation and documentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Degree Sought and Field of Training
rubrics_metrics.description: State the degree to be sought during the award and provide the field of training (items 20 and 21).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide expected completion date and field code (e.g., 980 Social Work).

rubrics_metrics.name: Current or Prior Kirschstein-NRSA Support
rubrics_metrics.description: Disclose current or prior Kirschstein-NRSA support (item 22).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If yes, provide level, type, dates, and grant numbers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applications for Concurrent Support
rubrics_metrics.description: State whether the applicant has applications for concurrent support and provide details if yes (item 23).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach descriptions of other potential or pending awards that overlap the proposed period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Citizenship and Visa Status
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide citizenship status and indicate if applicant expects to have permanent residency by award start date when required (item 24).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Declare U.S. citizen, non-citizen national, or non-U.S. citizen and provide visa/permanent-residency notes as applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Change of Sponsoring Institution
rubrics_metrics.description: If applicable, provide the name of the former institution and justification for change (item 25).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document approvals and transition plans for institutional changes during the award period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget — Tuition, Fees, and Stipends
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide requested tuition/fees and stipend/salary details (items 26–28), including amounts per year and total funds requested.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For senior applicants include institutional base salary, months, federal stipend requested, and any supplementation from other sources; ensure consistency with institutional policies and award limits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appendix and File Attachments
rubrics_metrics.description: Include allowable appendix materials and attach referenced files (item 29 Appendix).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow agency rules for permissible appendix content and ensure referenced supplemental files (e.g., Sponsor statements, Specific Aims) are included.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sponsor Team Expertise / Mentor Qualifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Demonstrate that the sponsor team has relevant domain expertise (e.g., neurologists for ADRD projects), and that co-sponsors/mentors are committed to training activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If reviewers note a gap (e.g., absence of neurologists), add qualified co-sponsors, describe their roles, and include coordination plans and letters of support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training Plan Development and Clarity
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a detailed, well-developed training plan with specific activities, timeline (e.g., Table 1), and explicit training goals aligned to research aims.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Address prior reviewer concerns that the training plan is underdeveloped by adding concrete activities, courses, internships, meeting schedules, and milestones.

rubrics_metrics.name: Methodological / Technical Training Adequacy (neuroimaging, statistics, programming)
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure planned training covers necessary technical skills (e.g., neuroimaging methods, advanced statistics, R programming), with mentored experiences and coursework.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Add formal coursework, mentored data analysis projects, hands-on work with collaborators' datasets, and letters indicating mentorship for technical skill development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clinical Experience and Exposure
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide clinical internships/mentored clinical experiences to ensure understanding of clinical contexts (e.g., memory clinics for ADRD research).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify mentors (e.g., neurologists), internship settings, and how clinical experience will shape research questions and intervention design.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appropriate Emphasis on Grant Writing and Scholarship
rubrics_metrics.description: Demonstrate that the trainee will allocate appropriate time to grant writing and scholarship rather than activities less appropriate for career stage (e.g., excessive teaching/mentoring).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document planned pilot studies, milestones for manuscript production, funding-seeking activities, and how time will be reallocated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preparation for Clinical Trial Methods and Implementation Challenges
rubrics_metrics.description: Show plans to receive training in clinical trial methods and to anticipate implementation challenges for intervention research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Propose expert-panel meetings, sponsor expertise in trials, and specific training activities to prepare for trial design and execution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Productivity and Milestones
rubrics_metrics.description: Demonstrate research productivity (published papers, manuscripts under review) and define milestones for training goals and expected outputs (e.g., 3 publishable manuscripts from dissertation).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use updated biosketch and publication lists to show trajectory and plan for maintaining momentum.

rubrics_metrics.name: Integration of Research and Training Plans
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure research activities and training plans are closely related so training directly enables the proposed research aims.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use existing datasets/ongoing projects to provide training opportunities that produce publishable outputs and skill application; justify mixed-methods when used.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training in Use and Analysis of Digital Biomarkers / Technology-enabled Methods
rubrics_metrics.description: Plan for training and participation in projects collecting/analysing high-frequency digital biomarker data (e.g., wearable sensors, in-home sensors, continuous monitoring platforms).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Participate in collaborative projects (e.g., CART), describe mentor expertise in digital biomarker collection/analysis, and detail planned hands-on activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mentorship Meeting Frequency and Coordination Plan
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify planned meeting cadence and coordination among sponsors/co-sponsors (e.g., biweekly online during F99; weekly in-person during K00; quarterly expert panels).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document explicit meeting schedules and responsibilities to demonstrate active mentorship and oversight.
